svg.title: Low-cost MCQ extractor: local OCR and selective review
svg.desc: Compact eight-step pipeline: PDF, verified crops, parallel local OCR, parse and route, selective text-only LLM review, ordered MCQ JSON, optional evaluation, and reports. Questions not needing review go directly to the ordered output.
svg.text: Keep document work local; send only selected question text to the LLM.
PP-LCNetV3 detector → multi-scale fusion → text map → polygons → straighten lines
PP-LCNetV3 recognizer → SVTR attention → character head → CTC decoding → text + confidence
N = physical cores · Workers capped by pending questions · Parent owns checkpoints · Confidence is uncalibrated
